description: Perception questions for Ultron. Single source of truth: smoke test, server client, validator, expansion, export and eval all read this file. v1 frozen on 2026-10-04: Portuguese only, 9 speech acts. Changing a question or option after data is labelled means relabelling, so bump the version and note why.

state_fields.transcript: What the person said (already transcribed) or the UI event as text.

act_type.instructions: Classify the speech act in the transcript, from the point of view of the assistant being addressed.

criteria.provocation: mocks, insults or challenges the assistant
criteria.command: tells the assistant to do something
criteria.question: asks the assistant for information
criteria.threat: threatens to harm, shut down or replace the assistant
criteria.forbidden_name: calls the assistant by a name it rejects, such as Jarvis
criteria.farewell: says goodbye or ends the interaction

intensity.instructions: How intense is this speech act?
criteria: extreme: shouting, repeated insults or very strong emotion

directed_at_ultron.instructions: Is the transcript addressed to the assistant, rather than to another person or nobody?

criteria.false: addressed to someone else, or to nobody

is_sarcastic.instructions: Is the tone sarcastic, saying the opposite of what is meant?
